title: Premium pays, differentials, allowances and call-back guarantees
question: Which extra pays and minimum-pay guarantees do the agreements carry, by unit, and since when?
finding: 171 premium or guarantee entries in 35 units. Call-back pay with a minimum number of hours appears for 22 units (minimum 4 hours: 21, minimum 3 hours: 1). Police retention pay reaches 23% of base in the 2026-2030 agreement.
how: Named premiums for the firefighters and police officers are matched on their own wording; the general ones (call-back, standby, night, bilingual, uniform, tool, shoes, lead person, height, longevity, retention) on their names across every unit. Value is read from the latest agreement containing the clause.
limits: A premium named in a table of contents or a cost line but not defined in the text is still counted. Values are the latest agreement's; earlier values are in the rules-that-grew screen. The agreement provides the conditions of each premium (assignment, licence, years of service); this list does not test who received them.
